categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在机器人策略自改进、多模态3D空间想象、循环状态量化与注意力效率，以及长视频记忆和推理结构扩展。

articles.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
articles.zh: 技能空间射击法：面向自主机器人策略的自我改进
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人策略的自迭代提升，这篇把改进动作放到技能空间里做随机打靶，不用人工干预也能往上爬
articles.author: Zihang Rui, Renhao Wang 等
articles.body: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful trials into policy improvement. Real-world experiments show repeated improvement in policies acting autonomously, while skills can also be shared to reduce the teaching needed to improve on new tasks. By making reusable skills a source of corrective supervision, skill-space shooting enables scalable and generalizable policy improvement within and across tasks. Additional results and videos at https://skill-space-shooting.github.io.
articles.bodyZh: 在现实世界里部署的机器人，必须能在遇到新情况和失败后，不断改进，而不只是停留在最初训练出来的水平。要让这种改进能扩展到各种任务上，它就得有效利用经验，而不是每纠正一个错误都得靠人来示范。最近的一些智能体系统提供了一条路子，可以减少这种对人力的依赖：它们用基础模型自主组合已学会的行为来完成任务。但这样一来，虽然任务能做完，却并不能教会某个任务策略去克服自己的失败；要做到这一点，得把这些行为转化成该策略可以学习的纠正信号。我们的洞见是，很多这类纠正其实都是熟悉的短行为，也就是技能：它们会在不同任务中反复出现，而且描述的是基础模型能够根据场景推理出来的动作。我们提出了“技能空间射击”，它利用基础模型的引导，在这些可复用技能中探索纠正方式，并把成功的尝试转化为策略改进。真实世界实验显示，自主行动的策略能够反复获得改进，同时这些技能也可以共享，从而减少改进新任务时所需的教学。通过让可复用技能成为纠正性监督的来源，技能空间射击使策略改进能够在任务内以及跨任务间实现可扩展且可泛化。更多结果和视频见 https://skill-space-shooting.github.io。

articles.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
articles.zh: Imagine3D-LLM：教多模态大模型在回答前先"想象"出3D场景
articles.summary: 如果你做具身智能或空间推理，这个思路是先让模型在脑子里补出3D场景再答题，值得试试能不能提点
articles.author: Jaewoo Jung, Hyeonseo Yu 等
articles.body: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
articles.bodyZh: 从多视角图像里推理三维世界，对多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）来说，仍然是个根本性的难题。现在的 MLLMs 处理单张图片已经挺在行，但要把不同视角看到的线索拼成一个连贯的三维理解，还是费劲。越来越多研究想把这个差距补上，办法是给 MLLMs 注入三维意识：要么增强细粒度的像素级跨视角对应关系，要么把三维几何基础模型（3D geometry foundation models）的特征融合进来。可即便如此，跟人类推理比，差距还是不小。在这项工作里，我们重新看了看人类的空间推理（spatial reasoning）。它说明，人类并不是靠很细的几何线索，而是先大致认出不同视角里相同的物体，再推断各个视点之间的相对几何关系，最后拼出一个粗糙的三维场景布局。受这个过程启发，我们提出了 Imagine3D-LLM，一个 MLLM。它会学着拼出一个类似的、紧凑的三维场景表示，并让答案依赖这个表示来生成。具体来说，我们在图像标记（image tokens）后面接上一小组可学习的摘要标记（summary tokens），把它们解码成一个紧凑的三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示，并用光度重建损失（photometric reconstruction loss）来监督；同时，还和标准的下一 token 预测目标（next-token prediction objective）一起联合训练。值得注意的是，虽然只有摘要标记直接接受重建监督，但这个目标还会让 LLM 底层图像特征（underlying image features）里的跨帧对应关系（cross-frame correspondence）变得更强。也就是说，学会重建这件事，会把三维感知信号（3D-aware signals）传播到整个模型里。结果就是，Imagine3D-LLM 在多个空间推理和三维理解基准（3D understanding benchmarks）上，稳定超过之前的方法。这说明，让模型去“想象”场景，可能比直接告诉它逐像素的几何信息更管用。

articles.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
articles.zh: STEPQuant：Delta规则循环状态量化中，误差何时、何处才真正要紧
articles.summary: 如果你正打算量化循环状态来省显存，这篇提醒你误差得挑时间和位置下手，无差别量化白掉精度
articles.author: Bingchen Yao, Haobo Xu 等
articles.body: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.
articles.bodyZh: 线性注意力（Linear attention）用固定大小的循环状态（recurrent states）取代了不断增长的 KV 缓存（KV caches），但在并发服务场景下，这些持久化的状态本身可能成为一个巨大的内存瓶颈。直接把循环状态量化到低精度，往往会导致严重的精度下降，因为量化误差会随着状态的连续更新不断传播累积。我们发现，这些误差的影响取决于两个互补的维度：在时间维度上，长期记忆中的误差会在许多解码步骤中持续存在；在空间维度上，不同关键行（key rows）的误差对模型输出的影响各不相同，同时状态值的大小在行和列两个方向上都存在显著差异。基于这些观察，我们提出了 STEPQuant，一个针对 Delta 规则（Delta-rule）循环状态的时空训练后量化（post-training quantization）框架。STEPQuant 根据误差大小和记忆生命周期来分配精度，并基于状态分布以及关键行对输出误差的影响，联合拟合关键行和值列（value-column）的缩放因子。在 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 上，跨长文本和短文本生成基准的实验表明，STEPQuant 在标称 6 比特预算下几乎能达到 FP32 状态的精度，并且在 4 比特配置下表现优于统一 INT8 量化。集成到 SGLang 并配合优化的 GPU 内核后，6 比特的 STEPQuant 实现了超过 5 倍的循环状态压缩，并将总服务内存降低最多 68.7%。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant 开源。

articles.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
articles.zh: LeapQuant：高效线性注意力与精确循环状态量化的结合
articles.summary: 如果你要跑长上下文的线性注意力模型，这个方法想让你在量化状态省资源的同时不牺牲精度
articles.author: Yi Pan, Haocheng Xi 等
articles.body: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of rounding errors and the presence of outlier rows and columns in the state. To address these challenges, we propose LeapQuant, a training-free method that achieves near-lossless performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization. First, to mitigate error accumulation, we propose per-window quantization, which leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the state only once at its end. Within a window, outputs are computed from the fixed low-bit state together with high-precision buffered updates. Second, to reduce the error introduced by each quantization, LeapQuant retains the state's largest outliers as a few high-precision Compensator Tokens, which share the update path of real tokens. We then smooth the remaining residual before quantization to further reduce the error. Comprehensive experiments across the Qwen, Kimi, and GLM model families show that LeapQuant substantially reduces memory and compute costs during inference. With accuracy comparable to the FP32 baseline, it achieves average speedups of 2.05--3.70$\times$ at the kernel level and 1.47$\times$ for end-to-end inference on NVIDIA B200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090 GPUs.
articles.bodyZh: 最近的大语言模型越来越多地采用混合架构，用线性注意力取代标准注意力，比如门控DeltaNet（Gated DeltaNet，GDN）和Kimi Delta注意力（Kimi Delta Attention，KDA）。这类架构虽然把上下文压缩成固定大小的循环状态，大幅降低了长上下文处理的成本，但反复读取和更新这个状态仍然是推理时的主要瓶颈。量化是降低这一成本的天然方案，但它会严重损害模型质量，原因是舍入误差不断累积，加上状态中存在异常值的行和列。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了LeapQuant，这是一种无需训练的方法，能在8位循环状态量化下实现近乎无损的性能。首先，为了减少误差累积，我们提出了逐窗口量化（per-window quantization），也就是跳过一个窗口的token，只在窗口末尾对状态量化一次。在窗口内部，输出由固定的低比特状态加上高精度缓冲更新共同计算得出。其次，为了降低每次量化引入的误差，LeapQuant把状态中最大的异常值保留为几个高精度的补偿token（Compensator Tokens），它们与真实token共享同一条更新路径。然后我们在量化前对剩余的残差做平滑处理，进一步减小误差。在Qwen、Kimi和GLM系列模型上进行的全面实验表明，LeapQuant在推理过程中大幅降低了内存和计算成本。在精度与FP32基线相当的情况下，它在NVIDIA B200、RTX PRO 6000和RTX 5090 GPU上实现了内核层面平均2.05到3.70倍的加速，端到端推理平均加速1.47倍。

articles.title: EmoRES-TTS: Residual-Enhanced Vector Steering for Emotional Speech Generation
articles.zh: EmoRES-TTS：残差增强的向量引导情感语音生成
articles.summary: 如果你在做情感TTS，用激活向量引导情绪这条路线，这篇给了一个残差增强的改法可以拿来比
articles.author: Kuan-Po Huang, Haohe Liu 等
articles.body: Emotion-conditioned text-to-speech (TTS) models may fail to express the requested emotion reliably, and improving controllability by additional training is costly in both computation and emotion-labeled speech training data. We therefore study vector steering, a training-free approach that modifies the internal representations of a frozen model. CoCoEmo, a conventional vector steering method for emotion TTS, treats each emotion vector as an indivisible direction controlled by a single global strength, limiting adherence to the requested emotion. In this work, we first discover that an emotion vector can be decomposed into a shared component that moves speech away from neutral expression and a residual component that directs generation toward the requested emotion. Building on this finding, we propose Emotion Residual-Enhanced Steering for TTS (EmoRES), a novel method that controls the two components without retraining the backbone. On IEMOCAP, EmoRES outperforms CoCoEmo across all four objective emotion metrics on the IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 backbones. Rank correlation improves by 26.13 and 12.97 percentage points, corresponding to relative gains of 118.8% and 33.1%, while emotion hit rate improves by 12.95 and 6.92 points, corresponding to relative gains of 20.1% and 9.8%. Human evaluation further shows a relative improvement up to 35.0% in the rate at which listeners correctly identified the dominant requested emotion and up to a 17.3% improvement in fidelity, while listeners prefer EmoRES for naturalness in up to 63.8% of pairwise comparisons. Component ablations further demonstrate that effective control benefits from preserving the shared component while strengthening the residual of the emotion steering vectors.
articles.bodyZh: 带情绪条件的文本转语音（text-to-speech, TTS）模型，有时候并不能稳稳地表达出用户想要的情绪；想靠再加训练来提高可控性，代价又很高：既烧算力，又得准备大量带情绪标注的语音训练数据。所以，我们研究了一种叫向量引导（vector steering）的办法：它不用训练（training-free），直接去改冻结模型（frozen model）的内部表示。CoCoEmo 是情绪 TTS 里一种传统的向量引导方法，它把每个情绪向量（emotion vector）都看成一个不可分割的方向，只靠一个全局强度（global strength）来控制，结果对指定情绪的贴合度就有限。在这项工作里，我们先发现，一个情绪向量其实可以拆成两半：一半是共享成分（shared component），专门把语音从“中性、没情绪”的表达里拉出来；另一半是残差成分（residual component），负责把生成结果推向用户指定的情绪。基于这个发现，我们提出了面向 TTS 的情绪残差增强引导（Emotion Residual-Enhanced Steering for TTS, EmoRES）。这是一种新方法，不用重训主干模型（backbone），就能分别控制这两个成分。在 IEMOCAP 上，不管主干换成 IndexTTS-2 还是 CosyVoice2，EmoRES 在四个客观情绪指标（objective emotion metrics）上都全面超过 CoCoEmo。其中，秩相关（rank correlation）分别提高了 26.13 和 12.97 个百分点，相当于相对提升 118.8% 和 33.1%；情绪命中率（emotion hit rate）分别提高了 12.95 和 6.92 个百分点，相当于相对提升 20.1% 和 9.8%。人工评测（human evaluation）还显示，听众正确听出最主要目标情绪的比例，相对最多提升了 35.0%；保真度（fidelity）最多提升了 17.3%；而且在成对比较（pairwise comparisons）里，听众因为自然度（naturalness）更偏爱 EmoRES 的比例最高达到 63.8%。组件消融（component ablations）还进一步说明，想要控制得有效，关键是保住共享成分，同时把情绪引导向量的残差加强。

articles.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
articles.zh: 超越时间线：用有据可依的实体传记增强长视频记忆
articles.summary: 如果你在做长视频理解，别只按时间轴切片段，给片中人、物立个"小传"可能是更管用的记忆结构
articles.author: Hui Ren, Lei Fan 等
articles.body: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.
articles.bodyZh: 回答关于长时间视频的问题，通常需要把涉及同一对象的事件跨越数小时甚至数天串联起来。按时间顺序的描述和从文本中提取的实体，可能无法解决物理身份的问题：不同的对象可能共享同一段描述，而同一对象的观察结果在不同事件之间仍然是断开的。因此，检索到相关事件，并不一定就能还原问题所涉及的那个特定实体的“完整经历”。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“有依据的实体传记”（Grounded Entity Biographies, GEB），这是一个长视频记忆框架，它把跨视频片段中对同一物理实例的视觉有据观察，归组成可检索的“传记”，同时保留每个时刻的上下文。在问答过程中，系统会同时检索“传记”和情节性证据，让模型能够利用记忆构建时建立的身份链接，跟踪一个实体在不同事件中的轨迹。在包括全天和整周录像在内的四个基准测试中，评估结果显示，它在选择题和开放式问答上都优于此前的记忆框架。在 EgoLifeQA 上，GEB 达到了 72.0% 的准确率，比已发表的最佳结果高出 4.4 个百分点。消融实验表明，有依据的身份关联和“传记”阅读都对性能提升有贡献，而仅仅增加额外描述，并不能完全达到这种效果。

articles.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
articles.zh: 基于教师监督的潜在信息反馈Transformer预训练
articles.summary: 如果你关心预训练架构里怎么加反馈回路，这篇把隐层信息回灌并配教师监督，是一个可选的设计方向
articles.author: Dor Tirosh, Ido Amos 等
articles.body: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LMs to propagate state across generation. We achieve this by turning recurrent-state learning into a teacher-forced prediction problem: each input token is paired with an information-dense state, derived from the next-token distribution of an off-the-shelf pretrained LM. The model, extended with a small number of additional parameters, is then trained to predict both the next token and the next state. As the input states are precomputed, pretraining remains fully parallel across positions. At inference, the model's own predicted states are fed back, with a minor computational overhead that decreases with model size. Experiments with pretrained models ranging from 135M to 1B parameters show that LIFT consistently outperforms standard Transformers and baselines on language modeling, downstream reasoning tasks, and procedural tasks under token-matched budget, while being on par with or ahead of compute-matched Transformers. Moreover, a controlled study on a state-tracking task shows that a tiny LIFT outperforms same-size Transformers trained on 8x more data, even when trained with the states of a Transformer that fails the task. Overall, we show that LMs can learn to exploit deep-to-shallow feedback during pretraining via scalable teacher supervision.
articles.bodyZh: Transformer 语言模型（Transformer language models, LMs）是前馈（feed-forward）的：深层的表示（deep-layer representations）不会回头喂给更浅的层（shallower layers），而信息在多次生成步骤（generation steps）之间往下传的唯一通道，就是那个已经解码出来的 token（decoded token）。这条通道太窄，逼得模型一遍遍重算中间结果（intermediate results），还得丢掉别的备选续写（alternative continuations）。在这项工作里，我们在预训练（pretraining）阶段把这个瓶颈拿掉，提出了 LIFT（Latent Information Feedback Transformer，潜在信息反馈 Transformer）架构（architecture）和训练方法（training method），让语言模型能在生成过程中把状态传下去。我们做到这一点的办法，是把循环状态学习（recurrent-state learning）变成一个教师强制预测问题（teacher-forced prediction problem）：每个输入 token 都配上一份信息量很大的状态（information-dense state），这个状态来自一个现成预训练语言模型（off-the-shelf pretrained LM）给出的下一个 token 分布（next-token distribution）。然后，我们给模型加少量额外参数（additional parameters），训练它同时预测下一个 token 和下一个状态。因为输入状态是预先算好的（precomputed），预训练时各个位置仍然能完全并行（fully parallel）。到了推理（inference）时，模型把自己预测出来的状态再喂回去，只会多一点点计算开销（computational overhead），而且模型越大，这点开销越小。我们在 135M 到 1B 参数的预训练模型上做了实验，结果显示，在按 token 数量对齐的预算（token-matched budget）下，LIFT 在语言建模、下游推理任务（downstream reasoning tasks）和程序性任务（procedural tasks）上，都稳定超过标准 Transformer（standard Transformers）和其他基线（baselines），同时跟按算力对齐的 Transformer（compute-matched Transformers）打平甚至更强。另外，在一个状态跟踪任务（state-tracking task）的控制实验（controlled study）里，一个很小号的 LIFT 甚至能打赢同规模、但多训了 8 倍数据的 Transformer，哪怕教它的状态来自一个在这个任务上失败的 Transformer。总的来说，我们证明了：语言模型在预训练阶段，可以通过可扩展的教师监督（scalable teacher supervision），学会利用深层到浅层的反馈（deep-to-shallow feedback）。

articles.title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
articles.zh: 思考之前先思考：用元推理扩展Agent推理能力
articles.summary: 如果你在搭Agent的推理链路，这篇的思路是先让模型做一层"元推理"决定该怎么想，再展开正式推理
articles.author: Paras Dahal, Anton Bakhtin 等
articles.body: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.
articles.bodyZh: 当智能体（agent）开始处理更长、更复杂的问题时，怎么控制整个执行过程，本身就成了一件事。每一步运行都会带来新的控制选择，比如：接下来该接着哪部分半成品往下做，要不要从头再来，什么时候该停。我们提出了一套叫“智能体元推理（agentic meta-reasoning）”的东西，它是在推理阶段用的一套控制框架（harness），把这些选择变成一个明确、有条理的推理过程。干活的是“执行器（worker）”，它们负责具体任务层面的计算；而“控制器（controller）”负责把这次运行已经搞定的东西汇总起来，探索下一步有哪些选项，评估每个选项在剩余预算下值不值得做，然后带着从持久记忆（persistent memory）里取出来的上下文，把选中的活儿派出去。两次决策之间，控制器不需要把整段历史回放一遍，只保留一份对这次运行的紧凑记录。我们拿来对比的基线，既有生产环境里的编程智能体（coding agent）和研究用的控制框架（harness），也有一个直接控制代理（Direct Control Agent），它用同样的执行器和同样的计算预算额度。在 ProgramBench 上——这个基准测试用“重建程序”来考察智能体做长周期（long-horizon）任务的能力——元推理配上 GPT-5.5 拿到 71.5%，而 Codex 是 58.0%；换成 Opus 4.8 时，元推理是 67.2%，Claude Code 是 65.5%。在其他基准上——覆盖抽象推理、多领域长周期推理和证明生成——它比直接控制平均高出 3.6 到 4.2 分，这是三个前沿模型（frontier model）平均下来的结果。在测试过的预算区间里，直接控制会卡在一个平台上不再涨，但元推理还能继续提升；不过预算很小时，它自己的额外开销也可能拖后腿。对产物图（artifact graph）的分析显示：它更多复用了前面已经做出来的东西，在大多数设置下对正确解的覆盖更广，而且最终挑选环节带来的提升并不均匀。这些结果说明：当智能体要处理越来越长的运行过程时，把算力花在有结构的控制上，会变得越来越重要。
